title: Adventures of Superman #442 DC July 1988 Byrne Ordway Kubert Powerless
conditionDescription: Light wear with small chips along the bottom edge; back cover toned with a dark spot at the upper right. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Adventures of Superman #442 (July 1988), DC Comics - "I have stripped you of your powers, Superman!" By John Byrne, Jerry Ordway and Kubert. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: TSR Forgotten Realms Black Wizards (Douglas Niles) ad.

Condition: light wear with small chips along the bottom edge of the front cover; back cover toned with a dark spot at the upper right (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
